016package org.vafer.jdeb.producers;
017
018import java.io.File;
019import java.io.FileInputStream;
020import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
021import java.io.IOException;
022import org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveEntry;
023import org.apache.tools.ant.types.selectors.SelectorUtils;
024import org.vafer.jdeb.DataConsumer;
025import org.vafer.jdeb.DataProducer;
026import org.vafer.jdeb.ProducerFileNotFoundException;
027import org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper;
028
029/**
030 * Base Producer class providing including/excluding.
031 */
032public abstract class AbstractDataProducer implements DataProducer {
033
034  private final String[] includes;
035  private final String[] excludes;
036  private final Mapper[] mappers;
037
038  public AbstractDataProducer(
039    final String[] pIncludes,
040    final String[] pExcludes,
041    final Mapper[] pMapper
042  ) {
043    excludes = pExcludes != null ? pExcludes : new String[0];
044    includes = pIncludes != null ? pIncludes : new String[] { "**" };
045    mappers = pMapper != null ? pMapper : new Mapper[0];
046  }
047
048  public boolean isIncluded(final String pName) {
049    if (!isIncluded(pName, includes)) {
050      return false;
051    }
052    if (isExcluded(pName, excludes)) {
053      return false;
054    }
055    return true;
056  }
057
058  private boolean isIncluded(String name, String[] includes) {
059    for (String include : includes) {
060      if (SelectorUtils.matchPath(include, name)) {
061        return true;
062      }
063    }
064    return false;
065  }
066
067  private boolean isExcluded(String name, String[] excludes) {
068    for (String exclude : excludes) {
069      if (SelectorUtils.matchPath(exclude, name)) {
070        return true;
071      }
072    }
073    return false;
074  }
075
076  public void produceDir(final DataConsumer consumer, final String dirName)
077    throws IOException {
078    final String name = dirName.endsWith("/") ? dirName : dirName + "/";
079    TarArchiveEntry entry = Producers.defaultDirEntryWithName(name);
080    entry = map(entry);
081    entry.setSize(0);
082    Producers.produceDirEntry(consumer, entry);
083  }
084
085  public void produceFile(
086    final DataConsumer consumer,
087    final File file,
088    final String fileName
089  ) throws IOException {
090    TarArchiveEntry fileEntry = Producers.defaultFileEntryWithName(fileName);
091    fileEntry.setSize(file.length());
092    fileEntry = map(fileEntry);
093    try {
094      Producers.produceInputStreamWithEntry(
095        consumer,
096        new FileInputStream(file),
097        fileEntry
098      );
099    } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
100      ProducerFileNotFoundException pe = new ProducerFileNotFoundException(
101        e.getMessage(),
102        e
103      );
104      pe.setFilePath(file.getAbsolutePath());
105      throw pe;
106    }
107  }
108
109  public TarArchiveEntry map(final TarArchiveEntry pEntry) {
110    TarArchiveEntry entry = pEntry;
111
112    for (Mapper mapper : mappers) {
113      entry = mapper.map(entry);
114    }
115
116    return entry;
117  }
118}
